name: compose-html-text
description: Text of HTML messages built without a compose window (saveDraft, a direct sendMail, a reply saved as a draft) with an identity that composes HTML. Thunderbird's own send path runs the editor's HTML through mozITXTToHTMLConv.scanHTML, which only reads &, <, > and " in text and escapes the & of any other character reference; an apostrophe typed in a plain body, or a reference such as ' or   in an HTML body, an HTML signature or the quoted message, must reach the message as the character, not as a visible '''. Direct sending is allowed for this scenario only (blockSkipReview = false); the message goes to the local mailpit sink. A body whose tag scanHTML cuts at a '>' inside a quoted attribute value goes as before, so that decoding never turns a neutralized moz-do-not-send back into an attribute.

Seeded mbox files have no .msf summary; running the (empty) filter list over the folder makes Thunderbird parse it.
